title: Chapter 6951: Where To Run?

Chapter 6951: Where To Run?

Chapter 6951: Where To Run?

“I haven’t thought much about your branch outside of destroying it.” Li Qiye said: “And since you are its progenitor, killing you accomplishes the task. Now, will it be you or me to carry it out?”

Breaker’s expression became ugly. He and other immortals would never accept this condition. Accepting defeat was humiliating enough, let alone committing suicide.

“You push too far!” Breaker shouted.

Although Li Qiye was a special existence and perhaps capable of killing primordial immortals, his demand was impossible to accept.

“I’m giving you a chance for a quick death, but it’s fine if you refuse. Start.” Li Qiye stepped forward.

Breaker staggered backward, lacking confidence. Meanwhile, the audience watched with bated breath.

They thought Breaker would at least last several moves. Perhaps Li Qiye would have to go all out to kill him. A primordial immortal was perfect for gauging Li Qiye’s power.

However, Breaker leaped into the river of time, running from one era after another.

“What?” They didn’t expect the notorious killer to run before exchanging a single move.

Of course, some knew Breaker only bullied the weak and cowered before the strong.

“I get it.” An immortal observed the fleeing combatant.

On the other hand, some were disappointed and thought his reputation was unfounded. They even looked down on his cowardice in the face of a stronger foe.

Meanwhile, he traveled through time at an incredible pace. Other immortals only saw shadows, not the real person.

Breaker knew he was fast and hoped he could escape Li Qiye’s reach.

“Where are you going?” Alas, Li Qiye blocked his path on the river of time.

He immediately leaped into a different branch millions of years away. When he looked forward, he saw Li Qiye again.

He turned pale but still evaded the man. Unfortunately, this repeated several times, making Breaker look like a lost dog or a headless fly.

“Bam!” Finally, the river of time somehow repelled him.

When he stabilized, he saw Li Qiye standing still as if the guy hadn’t moved an inch.

“What is happening?” Weaker immortals felt lost upon seeing the two again.

“This speed...” A primordial immortal found this unfathomable. He couldn’t detect Li Qiye’s movement in the slightest.
